Meta Platforms’ revenue grew from $134,902 million in 2023 to $164,501 million in 2024. [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt]  
Amazon’s net sales grew from $574,785 million in 2023 to $637,959 million in 2024. [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt]

Using these figures:
- Meta revenue growth 2024 vs 2023 ≈ 21.94%  
- Amazon net sales growth 2024 vs 2023 ≈ 10.99%  
- Difference in growth rates ≈ 10.95 percentage points (21.94% – 10.99%).

ANSWER: Meta’s revenue grew faster, by about 10.95 percentage points.
